privacy.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.privacy.lead: Dino Mutant Simulator ("this site") values your privacy and collects, uses, and retains your personal information according to the standards below.
privacy.privacy.section1.title: 1. Personal Information Collected
privacy.privacy.section1.item1: When signing up: Nickname, email, and password (stored encrypted; not even the operator can view it)
privacy.privacy.section1.item2: While logged in: Simulator profile data such as rune combos, constellation, and base stats set in the "My Dino" tab (settings for other simulators are not saved to the server and remain only in your device's browser)
privacy.privacy.section2.title: 2. Purpose of Collection
privacy.privacy.section2.item2: Email: Used only to send password reset links, never for other purposes (e.g. promotional emails)
privacy.privacy.section2.item3: Simulator profile data: Syncing your settings so you can continue on other devices
privacy.privacy.section3.title: 3. Retention and Deletion Period
privacy.privacy.section3.body: Collected personal information is destroyed without delay upon account deletion or deletion request.
privacy.privacy.section3.note: After logging in, tap your nickname in the side menu to go to your profile, where you'll find an account deletion button. You can also go there directly by clicking here. After a confirmation step, your account and stored data will be deleted immediately. If you're unable to log in, contact us at the email below with your registered email and nickname and we'll process it for you.
privacy.privacy.section4.title: 4. Outsourcing of Personal Information Processing
privacy.privacy.section4.body: This site uses the external service Supabase (an overseas service) to provide reliable service (authentication and data storage), and accordingly outsources personal information processing to it. Information you enter is stored on Supabase's servers, and Supabase's own privacy policy applies as well. We do not provide personal information to any other third party for any other purpose.
privacy.privacy.section5.title: 5. Security Measures
privacy.privacy.section5.body: This site takes technical and administrative measures to protect your personal information. Passwords are stored encrypted so that no one, including the operator, can view the original text, and database access is restricted to authenticated individuals only.
privacy.privacy.section6.title: 6. Data Stored in Your Browser
privacy.privacy.section6.body: Regardless of login status, simulator settings such as entered stats and rune combos are also stored in your device's browser (localStorage) for convenience. This data is not transmitted to the server (except for the logged-in "My Dino" tab), and is deleted when you clear your browser storage.
privacy.privacy.section7.title: 7. User Rights
privacy.privacy.section7.body: You may request to view, correct, or delete your personal information at any time. Please contact us at the address below and we will take action after confirmation.
privacy.privacy.section8.title: 8. Unofficial Fan-made Notice
privacy.privacy.section8.body: This site is not the official site for the game "Dino Mutant" and is an unofficial fan-made simulator with no affiliation to the game's developer or publisher.
privacy.privacy.section9.title: 9. Privacy Officer and Contact
privacy.privacy.section9.body: The privacy officer for this site is the operator themself. For privacy-related inquiries, please contact the email address below.
